fibres.name: canonical durable state model
fibres.falsifier: same logical state can receive incompatible snapshot identities or snapshot tampering goes undetected
fibres.next: integrate heads from existing RAKL state planes

fibres.name: raw evidence/object persistence
fibres.falsifier: blob corruption/rebinding survives verified read
fibres.next: define BlobStore adapter around current local CAS and production object backend

fibres.name: semantic Atlas/lattice persistence
fibres.falsifier: restart loses atoms/relations/charts or a relation can reference a missing atom

fibres.name: metric/decision/residual/saturation persistence
fibres.falsifier: resumed decision cannot reconstruct exact metric/saturation basis
fibres.next: persist certificates/receipts and bind heads into ProjectSnapshot

fibres.name: transactional transitions/concurrency
fibres.falsifier: two stale writers silently both commit or idempotency key changes meaning
fibres.next: PostgreSQL serializable adapter; retry whole transition

fibres.name: durable workflow orchestration
fibres.falsifier: worker death loses logical progress or duplicates an unprotected side effect without recovery state

fibres.name: target-conditioned query/index layer
fibres.falsifier: index loss destroys canonical knowledge or an index silently changes authority

fibres.name: canonical EpistemicStatus service
fibres.falsifier: UI and controller can disagree on status for same snapshot
fibres.next: runtime service adapter over real saturation/residual/solver state

fibres.name: controller-saturation-solver wiring
fibres.falsifier: solver runs on an unlicensed/stale knowledge state or search continues after valid bounded saturation without reason
fibres.next: wire assess_knowledge_saturation + hard gates + snapshot-bound solver compilation

fibres.name: API/CLI/service boundary
fibres.falsifier: mutating request has no idempotency/snapshot contract
fibres.next: versioned service API with transition receipts

fibres.name: observatory/dashboard read model
fibres.falsifier: UI recomputes its own epistemic score or cannot drill to exact receipts/evidence

fibres.name: distributed telemetry correlation
fibres.falsifier: a transition cannot be correlated across worker/database/blob/runtime boundaries

fibres.name: auth/access/secrets/security
fibres.falsifier: secret material enters canonical receipt/log or infra role changes scientific authority

fibres.name: schema/data migrations
fibres.falsifier: migration changes canonical identity/history without import/supersession receipt

fibres.name: backup/restore/disaster recovery
fibres.falsifier: restore cannot reproduce frozen snapshot/head hashes

fibres.name: deployment/configuration/environment identity
fibres.falsifier: two semantically different deployments share one runtime identity
fibres.next: deployment release identity and environment manifest

fibres.name: capacity/performance/load behavior
fibres.falsifier: load causes unbounded queue/index/context growth or violates registered latency/resource envelope

fibres.name: hostile reliability/chaos/replay assurance
fibres.falsifier: any planted partial failure yields silent partial success

fibres.name: software build/release provenance
fibres.falsifier: runtime cannot bind executable artifact back to build/source identity

fibres.falsifier: operator cannot distinguish retry/recovery/integrity/capacity failures from generic error
